other_failure_modes.name: Test distribution leakage via global encodings
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encodings and grouped aggregate statistics (mean encodings) on the combined train and test datasets before splitting. This leaks the distribution and features of the test set into the training data.

summary: The agent effectively parses the text and categorical fields to engineer multiple features and implements a robust cross-validation strategy with out-of-fold stacking. However, the solution suffers from data leakage because TF-IDF/SVD models and aggregated statistical encodings (frequency and grouped means) are fitted on the concatenated train and test sets prior to splitting.
